rating_encoding: finite decimal numeric source value equal to an integer from one through seven
missing_rating: blank; exclude that cell and retain denominator
human_poem_summary: arithmetic mean of observed primary-condition ratings by poem and field
prediction_poem_summary: arithmetic mean only when all three same-arm cycles have admitted usable scalars
primary_comparison: descriptive Spearman rank association with average ranks for ties, separately by endpoint and arm; at most ten poems
pair_comparison: five frozen disjoint pairs; assessor-matched primary-condition overall_quality directions; ties retained, missing cells unresolved
pairwise_prediction: all six AB/BA cycle observations must agree on canonical direction or native tie; conflicts/abstention/missing unresolved
other_dimensions: separate human descriptive counts; no invented comparator crosswalk or composite
rhyme: separate categorical field; missingness and distinct category count only, no quality aggregation
